Return Policy

We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you're not happy with your order, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to return most items for a full refund or exchange.

Return Conditions

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • In their original condition
  • Unworn and unused
  • In the original packaging
  • With all tags attached

How to Return an Item

  1. Contact our customer service team at support@example.com to initiate a return
  2. Receive your return authorization and shipping label
  3. Pack the item securely in its original packaging
  4. Ship the item using the provided label

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return, we will process your refund within 5-7 business days. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method.

Exchanges

If you need a different size or color, we're happy to exchange your item. Contact us to arrange an exchange.

Non-Returnable Items

The following items cannot be returned:

  • Personalized or custom-made products
  • Perishable goods
  • Intimate or sanitary products
  • Sale or clearance items (unless defective)
